acquisition_method: The variable window data in-dependent acquisition (DIA) method is described by Bruderer et al.
cleavage_agent: Proteins were digested by incubation with trypsin (1/100, w/w, Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin, Porcine; Promega) for at least 9​ h at 37​°C.
collision_energy: with a stepped normalized collision energy (NCE) of 25.5, 27 and 30
fractionation_method: fractionated with High pH Reversed-Phase (Pierce) into a total of 96 samples.
labeling: inferred: Precursor intensities were summed into protein intensities and the data was normalized with function justvsn() from package vsn (v3.52.0) per sample type and mouse experiment.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1​µg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
reduction_concentration: reduced with 5​mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45​min at 37​°C
reduction_reagent: reduced with 5​mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45​min at 37​°C

instrument.evidence: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1​µg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
